item.title: Senate advances bill to address Mississippi workforce shortage through community colleges
item.description: Legislation aimed at using Mississippi’s community colleges to address a growing workforce shortage has cleared one hurdle in the state capitol. Senate Bill 2522, which establishes the Upskill Mississippi Grant Program, awaits a floor vote after passing the Senate Universities and Colleges Committee.
